About the Digital CEA products

Listen with the feedback platform and automated analysis (QFA), connect through the contact center, and inform with HIA. Together, the feedback platform and the contact center form the Digital Engagement Hub (DEH).

Designed with National Societies, for National Societies

  • Collect feedback with one KoboToolbox form that works offline, face to face and online
  • Track every case until the loop is closed, with sensitive cases protected automatically
  • Feedback coded in line with the IFRC framework
  • Automated analysis (QFA) classifies and summarises free-text feedback, with a human in the loop
  • Triaging of feedback records (coming soon)
  • A contact center for voice and WhatsApp, with the feedback platform open next to every call and chat
  • Callbacks that keep the caller's place in the queue, transfers and end-of-day messages
  • Chat translation, so agents and people can each use their own language
  • WhatsApp surveys after a contact (coming soon)
  • One shared product, improved for every National Society at once
  • Shared feedback platform hosted by the Netherlands Red Cross, at no cost to your National Society

Getting started

Six steps from first conversation to go-live. Setting up the shared feedback platform takes around 40 hours over one month, including a few days on-site. You add the contact center when you need it.

  1. First conversation
  2. Readiness check
  3. Deployment
  4. Configuration
  5. Training
  6. Go live and improve

We talk about your context, your feedback channels and what you want to achieve. You see the products in a demo and decide whether to take the next step.

Together we check whether your National Society is a good fit at this moment. You need a CEA focal point who owns the feedback process and has buy-in across your National Society. We can help you find this person and build that support.

We create your National Society's space on the shared feedback platform. If you add the contact center, we deploy it and connect your phone numbers and WhatsApp account to the feedback platform.

We set it up for your context together: users and roles, your Kobo form and your feedback categories. For the contact center: languages, menus and call flows.

Your feedback team, and your agents and supervisors if you use the contact center, get hands-on training and materials to come back to.

You start handling feedback and closing the loop. We stay in touch, and new features reach you automatically through the shared platform.

Support

Our team supports you from the first conversation to go-live and after.

Help from our team

We help you set up, configure and use the products, and stay your point of contact after go-live.

Your CEA focal point

Every National Society needs a CEA focal point who owns the feedback process. We help you find this person and build buy-in across your National Society.
